G1722.def: ἐν — a primary preposition denoting position, 'in, on, among'; (fig.) by, with.

G746.def: ἀρχή — first place or power, i.e. (fig.) realm, authority; commencement.

G1510.def: εἰμί — to exist, be (the copula 'to be').

G3588.def: ὁ — the definite article (masc. nom.); before substantives, 'the'.

G3056.def: λόγος — something said (a 'word'), reasoning or reckoning; the Word (Christ).

G2532.def: καί — a conjunctive particle, 'and, also, even, then'.

G4314.def: πρός — 'to, toward, with', (fig.) the advantage, respect, relation to.

G2316.def: θεός — deity; the supreme Divinity; (by_repr.) a false god.

G1063.def: γάρ — a particle assigning cause, 'for, because'.

G3779.def: οὕτως — in this manner, thus; (with degree) so, to such a degree.

G25.def: ἀγαπάω — to love, i.e. welcome, be fond of; the highest kind of love.

G2889.def: κόσμος — an orderly system, i.e. the world (universe); the people on it.

G5613.def: ὥστε — a connective of result, 'so that'.

G5207.def: υἱός — a 'son' (literal or fig.), i.e. descendant, native, follower.

G3439.def: μονογενής — 'alone of its kind', i.e. only-begotten.

H1254.def: בָּרָא — to create, shape, form (always of God's activity).

H430.def: אֱלֹהִים — rulers, judges; divine ones; God (the supreme Divinity).

H853.def: אֵת — untranslatable marker of a definite direct object.

H8064.def: שָׁמַיִם — the visible heavens; the firmament; (fig.) the universe.

H776.def: אֶרֶץ — the earth (as opposed to heaven); a land, ground, country.
